body:
I'm a bit surprised there are no TCK tests for it. 

@FroMage @geoand @stuartwdouglas is it unsupported in Quarkus by design or by mistake?

It was likely done in the interest of time (see the code [here](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/main/independent-projects/resteasy-reactive/client/runtime/src/main/java/org/jboss/resteasy/reactive/client/impl/RestClientRequestContext.java#L137)) and since the TCK never checked and no one reported such a problem, it fell off our radar.

body: @mkonzal fyi, I checked classic RESTEasy and it behaves the same as REST Client Reactive

@michalszynkiewicz I just ran into this issue, but according to my findings RESTEasy Reactive does not behave the same as Classic. With Classic I'm getting the expected annotations in MessageBodyReader.

Here is a [minimal project](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/files/10818316/code-with-quarkus.zip) where `mvn test` fails when depending on `quarkus-rest-client-reactive-jackson` and passes when depending on `quarkus-rest-client-jackson`.
Is this still an issue with the latest versions of Quarkus?

> Is this still an issue with the latest versions of Quarkus?

Yes, it seems to be. [Here is an updated reproducer](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/files/14449718/code-with-quarkus.zip) that depends on Quarkus 3.8.1.

If you change pom.xml line
```<artifactId>quarkus-rest-client-reactive-jackson</artifactId>```
to
```<artifactId>quarkus-rest-client-jackson</artifactId>```
then `mvn test` passes.

Thanks for the reproducer!

I'll have a look

issue.title: Properly pass annotations to MessageBodyReader in REST Client
